fields.label: Gems — Submission Review Valid
fields.description: Awarded once per submission, the first time its review comes back as Success - Original.

fields.label: Max Submissions Per Student Per Week
fields.description: Separate from the per-assignment cap above — this one is weekly and counts across all assignments.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: A minted token is appended directly to this with no separator — end it in '/' or '?token=' as your receiving endpoint expects.

fields.label: Shared Secret
fields.description: Must match the Worker's MAGIC_LINK_SECRET exactly. Rotating one side without the other breaks every link already sent out.

fields.label: TTL — Home (seconds)
fields.description: 90 days by default.

fields.label: TTL — Feedback (seconds)
fields.description: 30 days by default.

fields.label: TTL — Gallery (seconds)
fields.description: 30 days by default.

fields.label: TTL — Submit (seconds)
fields.description: 14 days by default.

fields.label: TTL — Later (seconds)
fields.description: 14 days by default.

fields.label: JWT Secret
fields.description: Separate from the Magic Link secret above — these two must never be shared. Rotating this signs out every phone token already issued.

fields.label: JWT Algorithm
fields.description: Any PyJWT-supported algorithm (HS256, HS384, HS512, ...). Changing this invalidates every token signed under the old one.

fields.label: Phone Token TTL (seconds)
fields.description: 90 days by default. Set to 0 for a token that never expires on its own — only JWT Secret rotation can invalidate it then.

fields.label: Upload Ticket TTL (seconds)
fields.description: How long a student has to finish an upload after requesting one. 10 minutes by default.

fields.label: Config Cache TTL (seconds)
fields.description: How long this document is held in memory before re-reading from the database.

fields.label: DB Retry Attempts
fields.description: Total tries for a query hitting a deadlock or serialization error. 1 = no retrying.

fields.label: DB Retry Backoff (ms)
fields.description: Fixed delay between retry attempts — no exponential growth.

fields.label: Shared Logs Retention (days)
fields.description: Older job-run log rows are purged nightly after that night's own logs are written, so tonight's run is never at risk.

fields.label: Bucket Name
fields.description: Must match the Worker's own R2_SUBMISSIONS_BUCKET_NAME.

fields.label: Shared Secret
fields.description: Sent as the X-Internal-Secret header on every Frappe → Worker call.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off = tonight's sweep is skipped entirely. Nothing is lost — pending submissions are simply picked up on a later run.

fields.label: Max Submissions Per Run
fields.description: Caps how many submissions get promoted in one night, so a large backlog can't turn into an hours-long run.

fields.label: Lookback Ceiling (days)
fields.description: Fallback window used only on the very first run, or if the sweep hasn't succeeded in longer than this.

fields.label: Rows Per Worker Call
fields.description: Should match the Worker's own INDEX_BATCH_MAX.

fields.label: Apps Script URL
fields.description: The deployed Google Apps Script Web App that writes each night's row to the sheet.

fields.label: Shared Secret
fields.description: Sent inside the request body (Apps Script can't reliably read custom headers). Must match the secret stored in the script itself.
